python3 -c "
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx')
ws = wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]

# Find ENO1
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    if row[2] == 'ENO1':
        print('Found ENO1:')
        print('protein:', row[0])
        print('Description:', row[1])
        print('gene:', row[2])
        print('gene_id:', row[3])
        print('Normal:', row[4])
        print('Tumor:', row[5])
        print('Ratio:', row[6])
        print('FC:', row[7])
        print('log2FC:', row[8])
        print('p.value:', row[9])
        print('adj.Pval:', row[10])
        print('is_sig:', row[11])
        print('compare:', row[12])
        break
else:
    print('ENO1 not found in gene column')
    # Check all gene values to see if it might be stored differently
    genes = set()
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=50, values_only=True):
        genes.add(row[2])
    print('Sample genes:', sorted(genes)[:20])
"

normal = 72896133.2946858

print(f'log2FC: {log2fc}')

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/Proteomic_data .xlsx')
ws = wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]

# Check the actual cell value, type, and format
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2):
    if row[2].value == 'ENO1':
        cell = row[8]  # log2FC column (0-indexed: column 8 = I)
        print(f'Cell value: {cell.value}')
        print(f'Cell value type: {type(cell.value)}')
        print(f'Cell number_format: {cell.number_format}')
        break
"
